step1_analysis.description: A single NMOS transistor acting as a series or shunt element in an RF transmit/receive (T/R) switch. It passes RF signals when the gate is biased high (ON state) and blocks them when biased low (OFF state).

paper_reference.title: A 0.5-m CMOS T/R Switch for 900-MHz Wireless Applications

insertion_loss.description: Signal loss through the switch in the ON state (S21) at 900 MHz.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted transistor has a very small width (5um) compared to a real RF switch, leading to a high ON resistance and thus high insertion loss in a 50-ohm system.

isolation.description: Signal leakage through the switch in the OFF state (S21) at 900 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Off-state capacitance is dominated by Cgd and Cgs in series, roughly a few fF. Impedance at 900 MHz is >20 kOhm. S21 ≈ 20*log10(100 / 20k) = -46 dB. Isolation = 46 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small transistor size results in very low parasitic capacitance, providing excellent isolation at 900 MHz.

ron.description: ON resistance of the MOSFET channel.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported, but implied < 5 ohms for 0.7dB IL

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters for W=5u, L=0.5u at Vgs=1.8V.

off_capacitance.description: Parasitic capacitance of the switch in the OFF state.

sky130_expected.calculation: C_off ≈ Cgd + Cgs + Cdb. For W=5u, L=0.5u, this is roughly 10-20 fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted transistor is much smaller than the one in the paper, resulting in proportionally smaller parasitic capacitance.

p1db.description: Input power at which the insertion loss increases by 1 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on Vgs and Vth. For Vgs=1.8V, Vth=0.42V, the switch can handle roughly Vpeak = 1.8 - 0.42 = 1.38V before clipping. P = Vpeak^2 / (2*50) = 19 mW ≈ 12.8 dBm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Estimated based on the maximum voltage swing before the transistor starts turning off during the negative RF half-cycle.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure ON resistance, Insertion Loss (ON state), Isolation (OFF state), and OFF capacitance of the RF switch at 900 MHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RF Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 LABEL_NET_0 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Biasing and RF sources
Vsrc N1_ac 0 dc 0 ac 1
Rsrc N1_ac N1 50
Rload N2 0 50

* Gate Control
Vgate LABEL_NET_0 0 1.8

.control
* 1. Measure Ron (DC)
alter @Vgate[dc] = 1.8
alter @Vsrc[dc] = 0.1
op
let id = (v(N1_ac) - v(N1))/50
let ron = (v(N1) - v(N2)) / id
print ron

* 2. Measure Insertion Loss (AC ON State)
alter @Vsrc[dc] = 0
ac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
let s21_on_db = vdb(N2) + 6.0206
meas ac insertion_loss_900mhz find s21_on_db at=900Meg

* 3. Measure Isolation and OFF Capacitance (AC OFF State)
alter @Vgate[dc] = 0
ac dec 50 100Meg 10Gig
let s21_off_db = vdb(N2) + 6.0206
meas ac isolation_900mhz find s21_off_db at=900Meg

let I_in = (v(N1_ac) - v(N1))/50
let Y_in = I_in / v(N1)
let C_off = imag(Y_in) / (2 * 3.14159265 * frequency)
meas ac off_cap_900mhz find C_off at=900Meg

print insertion_loss_900mhz isolation_900mhz off_cap_900mhz
quit
.endc
.end
